name: AIventory Connector
author: aiventroy

sections.description:
AIventory Connector seamlessly integrates your WooCommerce store with AIventory’s powerful inventory management platform. Get real-time insights, accurate demand forecasting, and intelligent stock recommendations.

Features:

  • 📊 Advanced Analytics – Deep insights into product performance, sales trends, and customer behavior
  • 🔮 AI-Powered Forecasting – Predict future demand with machine learning
  • 📦 Inventory Optimization – Never overstock or run out of products
  • 🚨 Smart Alerts – Get notified about low stock, dead stock, and opportunities
  • 📈 Multi-Store Support – Manage multiple stores from one dashboard
  • 🔒 Read-Only Access – Your WooCommerce data stays safe

How It Works:

  1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. Copy your API credentials from WooCommerce → AIventory
  3. Paste them into your AIventory dashboard
  4. Your inventory syncs automatically

Data Synced:

  • Products and variations
  • Inventory levels and stock movements
  • Orders and sales data
  • Customers and addresses
  • Categories and collections
  • Coupons and discounts

All data is securely transmitted and stored. AIventory cannot modify your WooCommerce store.

Support:

Need help? Contact us at support@aiventory.org
sections.installation:
1. Upload aiventory-connector folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu
  3. Go to WooCommerce → AIventory
  4. Copy your Store URL and API Key
  5. Enter them in your AIventory dashboard at https://aiventory.org
sections.faq:
Do I need an AIventory account?

Yes. Sign up for free at https://aiventory.org

Is my data safe?

Absolutely. We use industry-standard encryption and never store payment information. The plugin is read-only and cannot modify your store.

What data is shared?

Product catalog, inventory levels, orders, and customer data (no passwords). See our privacy policy for details.

Does this work with variable products?

Yes! We fully support simple and variable products.

Can AIventory modify my WooCommerce store?

No. This plugin provides read-only access. AIventory cannot change products, orders, or settings.

How often does data sync?

AIventory pulls data in real-time when needed. You can also trigger manual syncs from the dashboard.
